title: TileQuant: Tile as the Precision-Allocation Unit for LLM Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2611.07217v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces large language model (LLM) deployment costs, but preserving quality requires accounting for uneven weight sensitivity. Uniform PTQ uses one weight bit-width, importance-aware PTQ adjusts scales or reconstructs weights within that width, and column-wise mixed precision retains selected columns at higher precision. However, sensitivity varies within columns, so whole-column retention also protects less sensitive weights, while runtime outlier detection adds decoding overhead. We therefore introduce TileQuant, a training-free framework that assigns precision to hardware-aligned 2D weight tiles. Offline calibration provides input-activation-aware scoring from forward statistics for lower calibration cost and gradient-informed scoring from loss sensitivity for stronger quality preservation. Within each projection's retention budget, the highest-scoring tiles remain at 16-bit and the rest use 8-bit. T

translated_title: TileQuant：以Tile作为大语言模型混合精度训练后量化的精度分配单元
translated_abstract: 训练后量化（PTQ）可以降低大语言模型（LLM）的部署成本，但要保持模型质量就必须考虑权重敏感度的不均匀性。统一PTQ使用单一的权重位宽；重要性感知PTQ在该位宽内调整缩放因子或重建权重；按列混合精度则以更高精度保留选定的列。然而，敏感度在列内部也存在差异，因此整列保留同时会保护不那么敏感的权重，而运行时的离群值检测则会增加解码开销。为此，我们提出了TileQuant——一个免训练框架，它以硬件对齐的二维权重tile（分块）作为精度分配单元。离线校准提供两类评分：基于前向统计的输入激活感知评分（校准成本更低），以及基于损失敏感度的梯度感知评分（质量保持能力更强）。在每个投影层的保留预算内，得分最高的tile保持16位精度，其余tile使用8位精度。
tldr: TileQuant提出以硬件对齐的二维权重tile为精度分配单元的免训练混合精度训练后量化框架，通过离线校准得到的激活感知与梯度感知评分，让高分tile保留16位精度、其余tile使用8位，从而在降低校准成本与解码开销的同时更好地保持LLM质量。
en_tdlr: TileQuant is a training-free mixed-precision PTQ framework that treats hardware-aligned 2D weight tiles as the precision-allocation unit, using offline activation-aware and gradient-informed scoring to keep the highest-scoring tiles at 16-bit and the rest at 8-bit for better quality with lower calibration and decoding overhead.
